purpose: Test one minimal permutation-equivariant, pose-conditioned detector-dual initializer on the factorized variable-camera PoolFire proxy requested by the OERF advisor. The candidate must use only noisy per-camera observations, reported camera tokens and a camera mask at deployment, then pass through an exact reported-geometry A^T lift, an observable line search and one unmodified CGLS step.
scientific_question: Can a small set-conditioned model distil the observation-only detector dual produced by zero-start CGLS K3 well enough that one exact warm CGLS step matches zero-start CGLS K4 across held-out PoolFire trajectories, camera counts and factorized camera/observation errors while using 2A+2A^T instead of 4A+4A^T?
claim_boundary: This is post-open development on noise-free CFD fields with synthetic straight-ray BOS observations, synthetic observation noise and synthetic reported-calibration errors. It is not a fresh or external test, curved-ray evidence, experimental BOST evidence, wall-time or memory speedup, broad generalization, an algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.

data_contract.factorized_conditions: the exact 37-condition clean/noise/rotation/translation/intrinsics/pose/combined roster frozen by v128
data_contract.truth_rule: PoolFire truth creates the synthetic clean observations and is used for final reconstruction metrics only. The teacher dual, deployment model inputs, line search, refinement and all ablations must not use truth.

teacher_and_shell.teacher: the natural detector-space dual accumulated by zero-start CGLS K3 under each sample's reported geometry and noisy observation
teacher_and_shell.reference: zero-start CGLS K4 under the same reported geometry and noisy observation
teacher_and_shell.candidate_path: z -> h=A^T z -> Ah=A h -> alpha=clip(<y,Ah>/<Ah,Ah>,0,2) -> x0=alpha h -> one unmodified CGLS step from x0
teacher_and_shell.stage_a_ceiling: Before model fitting, insert the exact K3 detector dual into the unchanged candidate path on all 3700 opened-fit cells. Every held-out-trajectory aggregate compatibility gate must pass or all neural fitting stops.
teacher_and_shell.stage_a_interpretation: Passing establishes only that this frozen shell has development-set representation headroom. Failing closes this K3-dual plus restarted-K1 shell and must not be rescued by a larger model.

model.inputs: padded [B,12,2,16,16] noisy per-camera observations, padded [B,12,18] reported pose tokens, and [B,12] camera mask
model.architecture: shared per-camera 2->8->12 convolutions; shared 18->16->12 pose MLP; shared 24->16 camera embedding; masked mean and max DeepSets pooling; shared 58->16->8->2 detector-dual decoder; two learned component skip gains
model.set_property: Co-permuting observation, pose token and mask must co-permute the detector-dual output. Padding entries must remain exactly zero.
model.scale_property: Per-sample observation RMS normalization and odd symmetrization G(y,p)=0.5(base(y,p)-base(-y,p)) make the output odd in observation and restore its physical scale.

training.loss: mean per-sample squared relative L2 between predicted and K3 detector dual over active cameras only
training.outer_rule: each fold fits only the other four complete trajectories; the held-out trajectory cannot affect weights, preprocessing, stopping or fallback
training.stage_rule: Run the primary pose-conditioned model, the no-pose sibling and the fixed shared dual-ridge control only after Stage A passes. Additional neural seeds are authorized only after the primary model passes all five held-out trajectories.

same_or_lower_exact_cost_controls: fixed-lambda shared per-camera pose-interaction dual ridge followed by the identical warm shell
controls_and_ablations.dual_ridge: On each outer fit fold, fit one odd shared linear map from normalized local detector components and their products with the 18 standardized pose coordinates to normalized K3 dual components. Lambda is fixed at 1e-4; no held-out selection is allowed.
controls_and_ablations.no_pose: Train the identical 11484-parameter architecture with all standardized pose coordinates set to zero.
controls_and_ablations.wrong_pose: At held-out inference only, cyclically shift pose tokens relative to observations while preserving the camera mask. This is an intentionally invalid calibration control, not a deployment candidate.
controls_and_ablations.co_permutation: Co-permute observations and their matching pose tokens, restore output order, and require maximum absolute output difference <=1e-10.
controls_and_ablations.add_remove: Report every metric separately for 5, 7, 9 and 12 cameras; no aggregate-only success claim is allowed.

metrics_and_gates.paired_reference: zero-start CGLS K4 for the identical cell
metrics_and_gates.ratio_definition: candidate metric divided by the positive paired reference metric
metrics_and_gates.strict_model_pass: all eight p90/worst gates pass independently on every one of the five held-out trajectories, every row has the exact declared ledger, and permutation/mask mechanics pass
metrics_and_gates.control_dominance: A learned-advantage claim is rejected if one same-or-lower-cost control is no worse on all four held-out-trajectory p90 metric aggregates and strictly better on at least one, or if the no-pose sibling matches the primary within 0.5 percent on all four global p90 ratios.

execution_and_validation.dataset_barrier: Seal the 3700 deployment inputs, K3 dual targets, K4 reference metrics and sample roster before fitting any model.
execution_and_validation.prediction_barrier: Freeze all five primary-fold checkpoints before opening any primary held-out prediction score.
execution_and_validation.independent_validation: A separate program must rebuild the sample roster and reported rigs, independently recompute a declared subset of raw observations, K3 targets, K4 references and candidate metrics, reload frozen checkpoints, verify permutation/mask properties and reproduce all aggregate gates without importing the formal runner.

decision.if_stage_a_fails: Record the exact shell-capacity failure and stop v129 before model fitting.
decision.if_primary_fails: Record the held-out failure, close this architecture and do not scale to FNO, UNO or a larger U-Net.
decision.if_control_dominates: Reject the learned-advantage interpretation even if compatibility passes.
decision.if_three_seeds_pass: Call the result opened-fit variable-camera development headroom only; freeze one previously unopened public reaction-flow condition before any external claim.
decision.resource_gate: Fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline peak RSS are forbidden until a model independently passes accuracy, control and replication gates.
decision.real_data_gate: Experimental BOST still requires displacement images, camera calibration/pose files, repeated-measurement noise information and the laboratory-approved baseline.
